The [[Polar Bear]] is a [[charmable animal]] that can be found in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]]. It has the exact same model as a [[Black Bear]], except with a white [[skin]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
***{{NPC location|Bjora Marches}}
***{{NPC location|Drakkar Lake}} (south from [[Sifhalla]], halfway across the map)
***{{NPC location|Ice Cliff Chasms}} (a bit southeast from [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]] and south of the exit to [[Norrhart Domains]])
***{{NPC location|Jaga Moraine}}
***{{NPC location|Norrhart Domains}}

==Notes==
*A Polar Bear will usually [[spawn]] in [[Ice Cliff Chasms]], close to [[Boreal Station]].
*Unlike [[Black Bear]]s, Polar Bear does not have [[Brutal Mauling]], making its [[Damage per second|DPS]] the same as other pets.
*Polar Bears deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''
*One level 20 (26) Polar Bear is involved in a quest [[A Hunter's Pride]] in [[Jaga Moraine]]; it is not charmable.

==Trivia==
*There is a [[miniature]] with the same name as this NPC, the [[Miniature Polar Bear|Miniature Polar Bear]]; however, it uses the model of [[Ursula the White]], which shares same skin as [[Jingle Bear]].
*During their idle animation, polar bears move their head to look left, right then down.
